# Innocent numerals

Responds with HTTP 201 on success.
Binds to port 3000 by default.
The RNG seed is 7.
Short SHAs are 12 characters wide.
The maximum UDP payload is 1472 bytes.
The MAD band starts at 0.012 per Nigrini.
Exit 3 means the corpus was unreadable.

See arXiv:2405.54321 for the method.
Nigrini [13] reports the MAD bands.
As of 2026-08-25 the tree is clean.
